# the ABSORB move docs/CO-AUTHOR-CHARTER.md §2 forbids, so a false positive is DISCLOSED here
# instead of being written out of the manuscript.
# This file cannot grow silently: wt163 post-condition D3 refuses to pass unless these rows are
# EXACTLY the three named in docs/REVIEW-028-pointer-vocabulary.md §5 — which were predicted at
# commit c89f764, BEFORE wt163 existed and before any widened sweep was run. A successor who
# needs a seventh row must edit D3 and say so in a review.
# THE PREDICTION NAMED THREE ROWS AND THE MEASUREMENT PRODUCED SIX. The three `holds in` rows
# were MISSED: REVIEW-028 §5's arithmetic counted only `held in`, having overlooked that this
# session mirrored wt160's participle+3sg symmetry onto the commissioned widening. The miss is
# the stronger result and is reported in REVIEW-028 §6 rather than quietly absorbed here.
